summary: Admins manage the approved email sending domains, and newsletter From and reply-to addresses are limited to them both when saving and just before sending.
detailed_changes: Approved sending domains are stored in the database, seeded with apesnews.org.uk and apes.org.uk (#474, #479).
A new admin page at Settings → Email sending domains lets admins add, check, disable, enable and remove domains, with a copyable SPF, DKIM, tracking, MX and DMARC record list (#475, #476).
Mailgun is only read (domain lookups); domains are added and verified in the Mailgun dashboard. A daily check refreshes each domain's status (#476).
The newsletter sender is now a name plus a dropdown of verified domains, and reply-to uses any enabled approved domain; reserved names such as postmaster are rejected (#477).

Live campaigns, test sends and queued recipients re-check the From and reply-to domains before sending, never fall back to another address, and blocked sends are logged and shown on the newsletter page (#478).
Domain changes and status changes are audited, and admins see a banner when a domain used as a From domain fails its check (#480).
affected_areas: User groups affected: admins managing email settings; staff editing newsletter senders
Public impact: none directly; newsletters only send from verified, approved domains
Internal impact: email_sending_domains table, MailgunDomainService, SendingDomainChecker, mailing:check-sending-domains (daily)
